focusedEvidence: 11/11 new integrated semantic-action tests, all 26/26 audit tests and 623/623 full V3
details: Integrated authenticated PTT through the actual V3 gate, semantic plan, center call/unit resolution, constrained action executor and factual speech output. R06 (negations), R07 (compound), R08 (GET_CALL/SEARCH_CALLS), R13 (incident partial writes) and R14 (conflicting call nature) now assert fixed outcomes; all original R01–R14 assert the repaired behavior. Obsolete CREATE_CALL success-without-readback test expectation was corrected, not weakened. The workflow explicitly syntax checks all new modules/tests and verifies absence of earlier legacy dispatcher modules.
boundary: Paid model evaluation, real STT/TTS audio/noise qualification, full repo/mobile, newer main, live radios, broader Command Link integration, human takeover and deployment gates are separate and unverified. This is not a pilot or released feature.
